::: {.hub-head .column-screen}
::: {.hub-wrap}
<h1 class="hub-title">{{< meta title >}}</h1>

<p class="hub-subtitle">{{< meta description >}}</p>

Every release of Breeding Insight software, newest first. Filter by package to follow a single tool, or [subscribe to the feed](news.xml) to be notified of new versions.

These entries are generated from each package's GitHub release and changelog, so the [repository](https://github.com/Breeding-Insight) remains the authoritative record.
:::
:::

::: {.hub-body .column-screen}
::: {.hub-wrap .hub-layout}
```{=html}
<div class="hub-sidebar" role="region" aria-label="Filter releases">
  <button type="button" class="hub-filter-toggle" id="hub-filter-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="hub-filter-panel">
    <i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>Filters <span class="hub-filter-toggle-count" id="hub-filter-toggle-count"></span>
  </button>
  <div class="hub-filter-panel" id="hub-filter-panel">
    <label class="hub-search" for="news-search">
      <span class="visually-hidden">Search releases</span>
      <i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      <input id="news-search" type="search" placeholder="Filter" autocomplete="off">
    </label>
    <details class="hub-facet" open>
      <summary>Package <span class="hub-facet-selected"></span></summary>
      <div class="hub-options" id="news-package-options"></div>
    </details>
  </div>
</div>
```

::: {.hub-main}
```{=html}
<div class="hub-toolbar">

  </div>
</div>
```
